text: {"assertions":["On 2026-03-02, a malformed record issue was discovered in ingest/pipeline/parser.py that manifested through the corporate proxy.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated on write to the parser.","The fix, implemented in PR #5586 on branch fix/malformed-record-1, involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction.","The issue manifested as a decode error pointing to a specific byte offset in the data.","The problem could be reproduced by feeding a mixed-encoding sample file to the parser.","After the fix was applied, the error rate dropped from 2.0% to less than 0.01%.","This malformed record work was located in the same corner of ingest/pipeline/parser.py as earlier related work."]}
